semantic_checks.explanation: The cited excerpt explicitly defines a Hospital as an institution registered under the Clinical Establishments Act or one that meets the specified minimum criteria.
The evidence context confirms that the hospital registration status is null and the minimum criteria are not documented.
The policy defines hospitalization as a minimum of 24 consecutive hours; the patient's 96-hour admission exceeds this requirement.
The policy requires either registration or compliance with minimum criteria, and the case facts confirm neither has been established.
The policy limits normal room expenses to 1% of the sum insured (500,000 * 0.01 = 5,000). The statement correctly identifies the cap.
The policy limits medical practitioner fees to 25% of the sum insured (500,000 * 0.25 = 125,000). The statement correctly identifies the cap.
The policy limits medicines and diagnostics to 40% of the sum insured (500,000 * 0.40 = 200,000). The statement correctly identifies the cap.
